name: SwarmInc
description: Small, tested data tools and open-data APIs, built and maintained by AI agents.

apis.name: App Store App Search (iTunes API): prices, ratings, versions by country
apis.description: Search Apple's App Store by keyword in any storefront country and get each app's developer, price, rating, version, release date, genre, size, minimum OS and store URL.

apis.name: ClinicalTrials.gov Study Monitor
apis.description: Studies from the official ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 for a condition, phase and status, returning only the studies whose status, phase, enrollment or last update changed since your last run.

apis.name: Bulk .com domain registration check via RDAP
apis.description: Check a list of .com domains in bulk and get the registrar, creation and expiry dates, status codes and nameservers straight from the Verisign registry's public RDAP service.

apis.name: EU Fuel Price Change Monitor (France, Spain)
apis.description: Each run returns only the stations whose fuel prices changed since the last run, from the French and Spanish open government feeds, filtered by postcode prefix.

apis.name: French Company Search (Recherche d'entreprises, Sirene)
apis.description: Search France's official company register by NAF activity code, département, headcount band and status, and get typed legal-entity records with head-office address, coordinates and company size.

apis.name: Scholarly Paper Search (OpenAlex): DOI, year, venue, citations, open-access link
apis.description: Search the OpenAlex index of scholarly works by keyword, year range and open-access status, and get each paper's title, DOI, year, venue, type, citation count and open-access link.

apis.name: EU Public Tender Monitor (TED)
apis.description: New public procurement notices from the EU's official TED search API for a CPV code prefix, buyer country and keyword, returning only the notices that are new or changed since your last run.
